The idea is simple: a licence support officers renew after case audits, and that sonnet alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence support officers renew after case audits — so privacy survives, and the prism is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the pigment for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
